offence_note: Arson; lifetime firearms ban imposed under s. 100(1)
sentence_quote: Leave to appeal sentence is granted and the appeal from sentence is dismissed.
note: Only the lifetime weapons ban is at issue; jail term not shown.

offence_note: Failing to remain after accident causing bodily harm; firearms offences
sentence_quote: I would grant leave to appeal in Marshall #1, allow the appeal and vary the credit for pretrial custody from 39 days to 107 days. I would not otherwise vary the sentence imposed.
systemic_quote: The trial judge referred to several mitigating factors, including Mr. Marshall’s age, the strong Gladue considerations, the severe post-COVID-19 jail conditions, and the significance of Mr. Marshall’s guilty plea.
note: Two sentences, both suspended with probation (fail to remain 2y; firearms 3y); credit varied only in first; second appeal dismissed.

sentence_quote: the sentence of 46 months imprisonment is varied to 36 months imprisonment based on varying credit for pre-sentence custody from 20 months to 30 months.
note: Total before credit inferred as 36 plus 30 months; offences not stated.

sentence_quote: Mr. Liang, on the charge of manslaughter in the death Men Cheung, I sentence you to ten-and-a-half years of imprisonment.
note: Joint submission; intimate partner violence endorsement; victim surcharge declined.

offence_note: Aggravated assault, choking, break and enter, kidnapping
sentence_quote: the appeal is allowed and the sentence is varied to credit his 261 days of pre-sentence custody at the ratio of 1.5:1.
note: Credit 261 days at 1.5:1 is about 391 days; only credit changed.

sentence_quote: I would grant leave to appeal, allow the appeal, set aside the order of Justice Cacchione and impose a period of incarceration of two years, which was the original sentence sought by the Crown.
note: Suspended sentence replaced by 2 years, served concurrently with robbery sentence; restitution ordered.

offence_note: Offences not shown; dangerous offender declaration upheld
sentence_quote: the trial judge’s determination that the appellant should be declared a dangerous offender was a reasonable determination.
note: Underlying offences not stated; Gladue report considered but indeterminate detention imposed.

sentence_quote: the appeal is allowed only to the extent of varying the term of the appellant’s driving prohibition from ten years to five years.
note: Custodial term already served; only driving prohibition reduced from 10 to 5 years.

offence_note: Robbery and use of imitation firearm during robbery
sentence_quote: On Count 1, the robbery, Mr. Radacina is sentenced to one day imprisonment, to be served consecutive to the sentence on Count 3, use of an imitation firearm while committing robbery, which is a sentence of three years' imprisonment, consecutive to Count 1.
note: Three years mandatory minimum on imitation firearm count plus one day; regional psychiatric centre recommended; surcharge waived.

offence_note: Contempt of court for refusing to testify at murder trial
sentence_quote: Mr. Geoghegan, you shall be sentenced to a period of imprisonment for 18 months consecutive to any sentence that you are presently serving.
note: Joint submission; consecutive to sentence already being served.

offence_note: Incest and sexual assault of half sister (youth)
sentence_quote: I would substitute a sentence of a two year ISSO on the terms imposed by the sentencing judge to deleting the terms relating to the CSO, accompanied by a concurrent six month DCSO.
systemic_quote: Given the dramatically disadvantaged aboriginal background endured by the appellant, a two year order maximises the possibility that the objectives of the youth sentencing regime will be achieved in fact.
note: Youth sentence: 2-year ISSO plus concurrent 6-month deferred custody order; custody removed.

sentence_quote: we grant the appellant leave to appeal sentence, but dismiss the sentence appeal.
